extension.description: Standalone Chaturbate Kodi addon with priority-based TV mode, local favorites, and HLS playback through a localhost rewriting proxy.
extension.news: 0.7.3 - URGENT: TV mode now falls back to per-slug AJAX when the affiliate-onlinerooms endpoint times out on cold start. Real-world scenario tonight: chaturbate's affiliate API slowed to 30s+ timeouts, TV mode dead-started with no cached slugs. Without a fallback, every is_live call returned False and pick_target found no live targets. With the fallback, when bulk fails AND cache is empty, we hit cb_client.is_model_live(slug) per-query for THIS call only; subsequent calls retry bulk first so we recover automatically when the affiliate endpoint comes back. Pinned with regression test. 0.7.2 - TV mode list rows finally carry the state-aware ctxmenu (Edit TV Priority + Remove from TV + Add to / Remove from Favorites). Regression from - previous tv_list rendering passed nothing to ctx_items so right-clicking a TV entry showed an empty menu. Pinned with regression test. 0.7.1 - refresh_artwork now walks every Textures*.db it finds (Kodi 21+ bumped to Textures14.db; older addons targeted Textures13.db only). Forward-compat for whatever schema bump comes next. Tolerates schema-mismatched DBs gracefully (skip with log, don't crash). Added regression tests for both the dual-DB walk and the schema-mismatch skip path. 0.7.0 - Tier-Next button no longer stops TV mode (real bug, not by design): clicking Next in the player to switch between live tier members was firing TAKEOVER because the queued plugin URLs got resolved to localhost proxy URLs before onAVStarted saw them, so the "is this in our queue?" check always failed. Fixed with a playlist-coherence fallback: if path is 127.0.0.1 AND playlist size matches queued count AND position is valid, treat as internal advance. User direct-play (which replaces the playlist) still fires takeover correctly. Plus three new features: max_resolution setting (auto / 1080p / 720p / 480p) caps ISA's variant pick to reduce buffering on slow edges. Two new menu items at the bottom of the main menu: "Refresh artwork" clears Kodi's Textures13.db cache for the addon (icon/fanart never auto-refresh after an update); "Restart Kodi" runs Quit (LibreELEC respawns) to clear stuck audio renderer state without ssh. 0.6.9 - TV mode now uses the same single-call affiliate-onlinerooms endpoint as Online Favorites for live-set detection. Was doing 60 sequential per-slug AJAX calls per poll cycle; now 1 affiliate fetch with TTL aligned to poll_minutes. Network failure keeps the stale slug set so a transient 5xx doesn't mark every model offline. Plus: hls_proxy startup race fixed (refresh/trigger callback closures now populated BEFORE thread.start() instead of after - a request landing in the gap was calling None()). Pure-store modules (tv_store, favs_store) now log load/save events. fav_add and fav_remove get entry/exit log lines. Stale docstrings in cb_client and cb_resolve updated. New tests/test_color_regression.py walks every emitted [COLOR] tag and pins Lesson 4 (8-char AARRGGBB only). Four new lessons added to docs/LESSONS-LEARNED.md (21-24). 0.6.8 - Browse views now client-side sort by viewers descending. The room-list API returns rooms in mixed order (top ~8 high-traffic then a roughly random tail) - same behavior has, neither addon was sorting. Top Cams / Female / Male / Couple / Trans / Search now show most-watched on top, walking down. New Cams left alone (recently-online ordering is the point). Plus: per-gender toggles in settings (Show Female / Show Male / Show Couple / Show Trans, all default on). Toggle off any category you don't want cluttering the main menu. Favorites and TV mode lists are NOT filtered by these toggles - those are personal collections you picked yourself. 0.6.7 - URGENT: dropped the on-disk bulk-fetch cache. Versions 0.6.3 - 0.6.6 cached the slug set (only) on disk for 30 minutes; on a disk-cache hit the online favs rendered WITHOUT thumbnails or plot info because the model-rich data was in-memory only. Now memory-only cache (30s TTL); each Online Favorites entry past the TTL does a fresh single-call affiliate fetch which is sub-second anyway. Legacy ``bulk_live_cache.json`` files get cleaned up on first call. Online favs render with thumbnails + viewer counts + plot info on every fresh fetch. 0.6.6 - Switched bulk-fetch to chaturbate's single-call affiliate-onlinerooms endpoint ('s pattern). Was walking 50 pages of /api/ts/roomlist/ at 100/page (5-10s); now does ONE GET to /affiliates/api/onlinerooms/?format=json&wm=XXX which returns ALL online rooms in a single ~7MB response. Same coverage, sub-second response. In-memory cache TTL dropped from 5min to 60s since each fresh fetch is now fast. Watermark rotates from 's array (matches the user's pre-existing affiliate distribution). Plus new cb_listing.parse_affiliate_onlinerooms parser since field shape differs (username/image_url/room_subject vs slug/img/subject). 0.6.5 - Online favorites now render with thumbnails, viewer count, and plot info on the left (matching the browse views) - the bulk room-list fetch already had the live-model data, we just weren't propagating it to the ListItem. Offline favorites stay as bare entries by design (we deliberately don't poll 1000+ slugs to get stale metadata; offline rooms have no live data to show anyway). Plus: docs sweep - LESSONS-LEARNED gets six new entries (15 API limit drift, 16 top-level menu network ban, 17 paginated rendering, 18 busy-dialog dismiss, 19 hot-path log noise, 20 long-running plugin invocation spinner). README + PLANNING current-state blocks updated. 0.6.4 - URGENT API contract fix: chaturbate's room-list API now caps limit at 100 (was 500); every bulk fetch was getting HTTP 400 'Bad Request' and Online Favorites showed empty even with live models in the user's list. Lowered _BULK_PAGE_LIMIT to 100, raised _BULK_MAX_PAGES to 50 to keep coverage at ~5000 rooms. Pinned with regression test. Plus: dismiss any lingering Kodi busy dialog at TV mode + favs entry points ('s pattern - prevents the "stuck spinner over playing video" UX after a previous slow invocation). 0.6.3 - URGENT favorites fix: 1224-fav library locked up the UI on . Top-level Favorites menu no longer triggers a network call (just shows Online/Offline drill-downs); bulk room-list fetch is deferred to category open. Online/Offline views paginate at 50 entries per page so the directory render doesn't choke on 1000+ rows. Bulk-fetch now has a politeness pacer between page calls AND a 30-min on-disk cache so re-entering Favorites after a Kodi restart is instant. Per-segment / per-chunklist hls_proxy "OK" log lines dropped (1+/sec was flooding the feature log during steady-state playback); errors and reconnects still log. 0.6.2 - QA HIGH bundle: HLS proxy now rewrites EXT-X-RENDITION-REPORT URI in chunklist bodies (LL-HLS quality-switch fetches were going direct to chaturbate edges and getting 403'd). chaturbatetv_active literal centralized in tv_state.ACTIVE_KEY (was duplicated across tv_loop, addon_actions). TV playlist URLs now derive slug from TVEntry.url instead of using the display name (broke playback for any user-customized name; ``Alice the Cam Star`` was being passed where ``alice`` belonged). Migration tool no longer crashes when source favorites.db lacks the expected schema (table missing, wrong columns, etc). 0.6.1 - QA fix bundle: Search row routes to mode=search_prompt (was a dead route to the renderer that closes on empty query). TV-mode offline auto-skip lands (Lesson v6.1) - when the active TV playlist hits an offline slug, fire Action(Next) so the player advances instead of sitting on a black screen. Settings.xml entries finally read in production: poll_minutes (TV loop interval), isa_proxy_port (fixed-port option for locked-down LANs), screensaver_color (cyan / green / hotpink). New addon_settings module centralizes the read+clamp+default behavior. 0.6.0 - Phase 5: TV mode lands. _TVPlayer subclass with state-reset between iterations (Lesson 10), file-switch takeover detection (Lesson 11), idle-time disambiguator at the stop site (Lesson 17), random-tier pick (Lesson 14). Idle screensaver via xbmcgui.Window (NOT WindowDialog - Lesson 20) with HALO cyan bouncing label, periodic re-walk every 60s. tv_play / tv_stop / tv_list / tv_add / tv_remove / tv_edit verbs all wired through tv_store. Browse + favs rows now show a state-aware right-click menu (Add to TV vs In TV / Edit / Remove; Add to Favorites vs Remove from Favorites). Verbose logging gated on enh_debug across the new modules. 0.5.0 - Phase 4c: HLS proxy hardened with the eleven PR #1818 lessons. Chunklists and segments now route through 127.0.0.1 so ISA always uses our headers (was 403ing direct CDN hits). Gzip-aware fetcher, three-tier segment fallback, cached playlists during reconnect, lock-protected reconnect guard, watchdog after a successful refresh, terminal-flag fast-path (ENDLIST chunklists / 410 segments) so ISA tears down cleanly. Verbose logging gated on enh_debug across cb_client, cb_resolve, cb_listing, browse_views, favs_views, router, tv_state, hls_proxy. Bonus: favs menu now bulk-fetches the live room-list once instead of polling every favorite (~5s vs 4 minutes for 1224 favs, Lesson 11). 0.4.3 - Fix Cannot download manifest: cb_resolve switched to AJAX endpoint (reliable JSON) instead of the fragile HTML dossier scrape. Strip hashtag duplicates from the subject line (tag-line at the bottom already shows them in green). Light gated logging on the playvid path (logger._log -> chaturbatetv_feature.log when enh_debug=true). 0.4.2 - Phase 4b: playvid resolver + ISA props (Matrix+ inputstream key, manifest_type=hls, stream/manifest headers urlencoded, MIME hint, contentLookup=False); addon_actions.playvid wired through setResolvedUrl with offline notification. Browse + favs views now declare content-type=videos so InfoWall / MediaList view modes are available (thumbnail on the right, plot on the left). 0.4.1 - QA-driven polish: model thumbnails (real img URL not hardcoded), hover plot info (Age / Location / Watching / Followers / Tags), favs labels render (8-char hex), favs Online/Offline drill-down works (was a router gap). 0.4.0 - Phase 4a: localhost HLS rewriting proxy (MVP). Master playlist absolutize+rewrite, iPad UA + Referer header injection, dynamic 127.0.0.1 port. Stream playback hookup lands in 0.4.1. 0.3.1 - Fix [COLOR] tags: Kodi requires 8-char AARRGGBB hex; bare 6-char rendered Female/Male/Couple/Trans labels and model names blank. 0.3.0 - Switch browse to Chaturbates JSON API (room-list endpoint). Drops HTML scraping entirely. 0.2.1 - Polish: full-bleed fanart, provider-name fix. 0.2.0 - Phase 2: browse menus (Top, New, Female, Male, Couple, Trans, Search), local favorites, migration tool.
